To Edit, you must set a default application to open '.crpl' files.
On Windows, select an editor (like Notepad.exe, or the freely available Notepad++). Alternately, you can browse to the script on disk, right click, select properties, and click the 'Change' button next to 'Opens With'.
You only have to do this once.
On OSX, right click the file and select 'Open With'.

strings.en:
Select a terrain level, then select a texture below from the palette.
Click the 'APPLY IMAGE TO TERRAIN' button to assign the image to the selected terrain level.
Once finished, click the 'Close and Apply Changes' button to apply all changes to the map.
The numbers under each terrain level are brightness. 0 is dark, 100 is bright, 50 is normal

Resizing the map will increase or decrease the amount of land.
If you decrease either dimension, terrain/units will get clipped on the right and/or the bottom.  Any clipped items will be lost!

NOTE THAT THE GAME WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY SAVED AND RELOADED AFTER YOU APPLY.  SO MAKE A BACKUP COPY FIRST!
